results.reason: Missing review policy and settling Core versus Leaf boundaries match the setup and classification purpose.

results.reason: Requests assessment of a diff against an accepted review policy, including risk and evidence preparation.

results.reason: Formal findings against requirements route to code-review.

results.reason: This is a request to implement CI behavior, not review risk classification or evidence preparation.
